opening.argument: The presentation is anchored in a historical account of technical-support work, expressly introduced as “my presentation on working for AST Technical Support, back in the 1990s.” It then explains the training involved in examining each machine, including “all the unique features of this machine, all the nuances, all the things that could break on this machine,” and discusses how AST combined those functions into a single expansion card. The slide on AST Computer’s decline reinforces the conference-talk and educational context. The Patreon and website links are presented as channel-support or browsing links, while the Planet X3 records and games appear in a giveaway and Q&A context, not as claims of guaranteed gain or outcome.

citations.quote: You came here to see my presentation on working for AST Technical Support, back in the 1990s
